reason: A DeepSeek Harness Cordis plugin that distributes and registers a broad collection of reusable engineering, agent, research, and technical pattern skills for on-demand guidance.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册并分发涵盖软件工程、智能体评估、研究和技术模式的可复用技能，供用户按需加载。
summaries.en: Registers and distributes reusable DeepSeek Harness skills covering software engineering, agent evaluation, research, and technical patterns for on-demand loading.

capabilities: Registers a skill provider with the DeepSeek Harness ctx.skills registry
Bundles reusable SKILL.md guidance for software engineering, agent evaluation, research, and technical patterns
Makes bundled skills available for model or user invocation through the skill tool
